globalAttributes.name: data-sd-open
globalAttributes.description: Opens the <dialog> with this id as a modal.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-close
globalAttributes.description: Closes the nearest dialog; a value becomes its returnValue.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-static
globalAttributes.description: On a dialog: a backdrop click does not close it.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-toggle
globalAttributes.description: Opens and closes the .sd-expand with this id; keeps aria-expanded in sync.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-seg
globalAttributes.description: Single-select button group (aria-pressed); fires change.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-key
globalAttributes.description: Clicks the element when this key combo is pressed (not while typing), e.g. "a", "shift+n", "mod+k".

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-tip
globalAttributes.description: Tooltip text shown on hover and focus.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-tip-side
globalAttributes.description: Tooltip side: top, bottom, left or right.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-side
globalAttributes.description: Popover side: top, bottom, left or right.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-align
globalAttributes.description: Popover alignment: start, center or end.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-anchor
globalAttributes.description: Positions a popover against this selector instead of its trigger.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-copy
globalAttributes.description: Copies the text of the element matched by this selector and confirms with a toast. If copying is unavailable or denied, shows a danger toast asking the user to select the line instead.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-toast
globalAttributes.description: Shows this text as a toast on click (data-tone colors it).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-theme
globalAttributes.description: Switches the theme (ink, graphite, paper, auto) and remembers it.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-theme-cycle
globalAttributes.description: Steps to the next theme on click.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-shell
globalAttributes.description: App shell control: sidebar (pin/collapse), aside (right panel), drawer (phones) or close.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-section
globalAttributes.description: On a rail item: shows the sidebar panel with the same data-section.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-window
globalAttributes.description: Title bar window button: minimize, maximize or close (Tauri window API, else an sd:window event).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-ornaments
globalAttributes.description: Square-dust ornaments painted as the background: br (default), tl, tr, bl, top, bottom, center or none; space-separated.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-ornaments-size
globalAttributes.description: Ornament size in px (default 340).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-ornaments-still
globalAttributes.description: Turns off the ornament sparkle on this element.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-edges
globalAttributes.description: Replaces the border with the glowing edge (bright corners, faint sides).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-rain
globalAttributes.description: Turns a <canvas class="sd-rain"> into the digital rain backdrop.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-rain-style
globalAttributes.description: Rain style: glyphs (default) or squares.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-rain-skip
globalAttributes.description: Selector for elements that cover the rain, so it skips drawing under them.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-rain-toggle
globalAttributes.description: Button that turns the rain on or off (remembered).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-fps
globalAttributes.description: Frame-rate counter; the number goes in a child <b>.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-combobox
globalAttributes.description: Text input with a filtered listbox (role=combobox, aria-controls).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-tags
globalAttributes.description: Tag entry: Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes; hidden inputs carry the values.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-number
globalAttributes.description: Number stepper: − and + buttons with data-step.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-palette
globalAttributes.description: On a <dialog class="sd-command">: a command palette with filtering and arrow keys.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-shortcuts
globalAttributes.description: On a <dialog>: the keyboard shortcut sheet; ? opens it.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-autogrow
globalAttributes.description: Textarea grows with its content.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-enter-submit
globalAttributes.description: Enter submits the form; Shift+Enter adds a line.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-suggest
globalAttributes.description: Id of an .sd-suggest list opened by the trigger character (mentions).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-trigger
globalAttributes.description: Character that opens the suggestion list (default @).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-contextmenu
globalAttributes.description: Id of a menu opened at the pointer on right click, Shift+F10 or the menu key.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-reaction
globalAttributes.description: Reaction toggle with a count; fires sd:reaction.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-poll
globalAttributes.description: Poll: choosing an option marks it and reveals the shares.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-chart
globalAttributes.description: On a <figure>: init a chart from its JSON <script> (initCharts from signal-design/charts).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-chart-scale
globalAttributes.description: Container of buttons (data-value clamp|p95|p90|linear|log) that switch a chart's scale mode.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-scroll-tab
globalAttributes.description: Give this scroll box a tab stop while it scrolls (tables and code get one automatically).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-scrollbars
globalAttributes.description: Set by init() on <html>: auto hides scrollbars when idle, always keeps them.

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-scrolling
globalAttributes.description: Set by the JS on a scroller while it moves (scrollbar shows).

globalAttributes.name: data-sd-scrolling-page
globalAttributes.description: Set by the JS on <html> while anything scrolls (idle motion pauses).
